# The Unapologetic Leader

> A movement and body of work by Amanda Friedt (also known as Amanda Farley) for high-capacity women carrying responsibilities, expectations, emotions, and identities that were never theirs to hold. It gives language for what you are carrying, permission to put it down, and tools to become who you were meant to be. Themes: leadership, identity, over-functioning, and becoming. A flagship initiative of FRDTLAB. Based in Detroit, Michigan.

## Core ideas
- The Difference Between Love and Carrying: the line between caring for someone and carrying them.
- The Human Cost of Competence: the hidden tax of being the capable, reliable one.
- Permission: the permission you keep waiting for was always yours to give.
- Cultivating vs. Controlling: great leaders build capacity in others, not dependency.
- Becoming: transformation happens one deliberate choice, one brick, at a time.

## Author
Amanda Friedt, also known as Amanda Farley and Amanda Friedt Farley. Detroit-based growth strategist, speaker, founder of FRDTLAB, creator of Unapologetic Leadership, and host of Amplify. Two decades in integrated marketing, AI-era search, and organizational transformation; founder of the One Step Forward Initiative in Detroit.

- [Messaging Terms](https://theunapologeticleader.com/messaging.html): SMS and WhatsApp messaging terms — consent, frequency, rates, opt-out.
